record.body:
## Evidence

Expected: the integration test runs the ci.yml lines without side effects. Observed: npm ci replaces the real node_modules during the run.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix work-item fix-gate-test-isolation moves npm ci into the temporary copy.

payload.basis: The test deletes and reinstalls the shared node_modules while other gate tests symlink it. The reviewer saw vite: not found during the window. Under pytest -n auto the tests race.
payload.claim: missing-test on test_web_job_run_lines_pass: npm ci runs in the shared dashboard/web/ui
payload.invalidated_when: The test installs in its own copy and the reviewer re-run passes

record.subject: review-phase-missing-test
